title: FIPS mode lookup rejection log omits which non-FIPS provider was skipped
description: fd.c:738-740: when FIPS enforcement is active and a lookup for e.g. ctr(aes) or xts(aes) fails because the only matching provider (kcapi) is non-FIPS, the log says 'not found — FIPS mode active; ensure a FIPS provider registers this algo' — but does NOT identify which non-FIPS provider was skipped. The support engineer knows FIPS blocked it but must manually cross-reference the sysfs algorithms file to determine 'kcapi had this algo and was rejected'. crypto2dev_lookup_algo has no mechanism to record skipped-due-to-FIPS matches. Same gap exists in ioctl_key_import (1651-1656), ioctl_do_kdf (1858-1863), ioctl_key_generate (2024-2029). Fix options: (a) add a second pass in lookup_algo that returns the first skipped-but-would-have-matched provider name, include it in the log, or (b) add a pr_debug inside the FIPS-skip branch of lookup_algo that names the provider being skipped.
